jobs.title: GenAI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.jd: Das baust du mit uns auf Wo kann KI unseren Kunden weiterhelfen und unseren Mitarbeitenden Arbeit abnehmen? Du entwickelst die Lösungen dafür. Wir bauen ein neues digitales Brokerage auf - mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Als GenAI Engineer gestaltest du von Anfang an mit, wo und wie wir Sprachmodelle sinnvoll einsetzen: vom Kundenservice-Assistenten bis zur automatisierten Dokumentenverarbeitung. Dabei bringst du praktische Umsetzung, nachvollziehbare Ergebnisse und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten zusammen. Das wirst du bei uns machen Du entwickelst Anwendungen auf Basis großer Sprachmodelle (LLMs), beispielsweise Kundenservice-Assistenten, FAQ-Bots auf geprüftem Wissen, Dokumentenverarbeitung oder interne Assistenz für die Fachbereiche. Du stellst interne KI-Tools bereit und automatisierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen wiederkehrende Abläufe durch Assistenten und Workflows. Du baust Wissensbasen für KI-Anwendungen auf und bindest sie über Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) an. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass relevante Informationen auffindbar und aktuell bleiben. Du gestaltest Prompts, Workflows und technische Leitplanken (Guardrails), um fehlerhafte Antworten zu begrenzen, Quellen nachvollziehbar zu machen und vorgegebene Nutzungsgrenzen umzusetzen. Du bindest Sprachmodelle gemeinsam mit den IT- und Plattformteams an bestehende Systeme und Datenquellen an und begleitest die Anwendungen in den produktiven Einsatz. Du testest die Anwendungen anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle, wertest Fehler und Nutzerfeedback aus und verbesserst Antworten und Abläufe gezielt. Du bewertest neue KI-Tools und Modelle pragmatisch nach Nutzen, Qualität, Aufwand und Kosten. Du arbeitest eng mit dem AI Quality & Governance Specialist, der Informationssicherheit und dem Datenschutz zusammen und setzt abgestimmte Anforderungen technisch um. Das bringst du mit Du hast KI- oder Automatisierungsanwendungen praktisch umgesetzt und bereits eigene Lösungen von der Anforderung bis zur Nutzung begleitet. Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung mit. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Schnittstellen, Retrieval-Augmented Generation und Prompt-Design. Du kannst KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Abläufe mit geeigneten Frameworks und Workflow-Tools umsetzen, beispielsweise LangChain oder n8n. Du verstehst die Grenzen von Sprachmodellen und kannst Antworten, Fehlerfälle und die Qualität eingebundener Wissensquellen kritisch beurteilen. Du kennst die für deine Arbeit relevanten Anforderungen aus Datenschutz und EU AI Act und kannst sie gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern in technische Lösungen übersetzen. Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, erklärst KI verständlich und entwickelst Lösungen im engen Austausch mit den späteren Nutzern. Du bist neugierig, testest Ideen zügig und entwickelst sie anhand von Ergebnissen und Feedback weiter. Du arbeitest pragmatisch, eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert, setzt klare Prioritäten und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss Kenntnisse in Python. Erfahrung mit KI-Anwendungen im Finanzsektor oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Kundenservice-Assistenten, Dokumentenverarbeitung oder internen Wissensassistenten. Erfahrung mit systematischen Tests und der laufenden Überwachung von LLM-Anwendungen. Das erwartet dich bei uns Raum für deine Ideen: Hier kannst du nicht nur mitreden, sondern mitgestalten. Deine Ideen sind gefragt und du hast die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln. Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbruchstimmung treffen auf die Sicherheit und Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Deine Benefits Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Product Analytics
jobs.jd:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

  • The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Fin use data and insights to drive evidence based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data — both big and small — to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. If you get really excited about asking the right questions, exploring patterns in data and surfacing actionable insights that drive strategic decisions, then this role is for you.
  • Data Scientists in RAD partner with teams across R&D to help Fin make sense of our users, our products and our business, using metrics and data. This role will enable you to drive key data projects that directly impact our customers and millions of end users who communicate via our messaging platform daily.

What will I be doing? 

  • You’ll partner with product teams to help them identify important questions and answer those questions with data
  • You’ll work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to develop key product success metrics, to set targets, to measure results and outcomes, and to size opportunities
  • You’ll design, build and update end-to-end data pipelines, working closely with stakeholders to drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data sources and tables.
  • You’ll partner closely with product researchers to build a holistic understanding of our customers, our products and our business.
  • You’ll influence our product roadmap and product strategy through experimentation, exploratory analysis and quantitative research
  • You’ll build and automate actionable models and dashboards
  • You’ll craft data stories and share your findings and recommendations across R&D and the broader company
  • You’ll drive and shape core RAD foundations and help us improve how the RAD org operates

What skills do I need? 

  • 5 + years experience working with data to solve problems and drive evidence-based decisions
  • Excellent SQL skills and experience of  applying analytical and statistical approaches to problem solving
  • Proven track record of initiating and delivering actionable analysis and insights that drives tangible impact with minimal supervision
  • Excellent communication skills (technical and non-technical) and a focus on driving impact
  • Strong growth mindset and sense of ownership. Innate passion and curiosity
  • Experience with a scientific computing language (such as R or Python)

Bonus skills & attributes 

  • Experience with BI/Visualization tools like Tableau, Superset and Looker
  • Experience with data modeling and ETL pipelines
  • Experience working with product teams
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to boost efficiency and creativity across the data science workflow — from ideation and coding to analysis and communication

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. jobs.jd: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The role The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance. As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering. Understand what drives performance Explore our conversational and behavioural data, alongside campaign performance Track our key metrics, spot what moves, and find out why Surface the hidden patterns that make recommendations more relevant Ship your findings to production Turn your findings into improvements to our recommendation algorithms and agents, implemented in production Measure the impact directly with A/B tests, and feed the results into the next iteration Industrialise the analyses you run often into automated pipelines and monitoring, reviewed by the engineering team Improve our agents in production Maintain and improve our agents: prompts, tools, evaluation, and the code around them Turn client feedback into agent improvements: qualify what they ask for, and ship directly what can be handled at the agent level Automate operations at scale Build and maintain Claude Code skills that automate operational work at scale and free up time for the business team Profile Must-have 0 to 3 years of experience, internships and work-study included. Fresh graduates are welcome. jobs.jd: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta ’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta ’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta . If you love working from first principles in a rapid iteration loop with customers - this is your chance to have an outsized impact on the customer experience industry. jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team The Workforce Machine Learning (WFML) team is helping transform how HCM and Workforce is processed for Workday customers around the world. Compensation touches nearly everyone who works, and the data behind it is complex, time-sensitive, and deeply important. Our work helps customers process Compensation more accurately, efficiently, and confidently, so employees can be provided with right compensation package during their tenure correctly. We work with large-scale HR and Compensation datasets to build data and AI-driven solutions that improve the Compensation experience for administrators. In the year ahead, the team will focus on applying modern machine learning, generative AI, and AI agent technologies to deliver predictive analytics, recommendations, and automation that make Compensation benchmarking simpler and more effective.This is a team for people who enjoy solving meaningful problems with data. We value curiosity, thoughtful collaboration, and practical innovation. You will work with people who care about building trustworthy AI solutions that create real value for Workday customers and support Workday’s mission to make work better. About the Role As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will help design, develop, and deliver AI and machine learning solutions that support HCM & Compensation products at global scale. You will work with product managers, software engineers, data scientists, and other partners to understand customer needs and turn rich HR and Compensation data into useful product experiences. You will use Workday’s AI development environment and tools to explore data, build models, evaluate performance, and help bring machine learning capabilities into production. Your work will support predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and automated experiences that help Compensation administrators work more efficiently. In this role, you will: Develop data and AI-driven solutions for enterprise HR and Compensation products serving organizations of many sizes and industries. Explore, prepare, and transform large-scale HR and Compensation datasets for machine learning use cases. Design, build, evaluate, and improve machine learning models, prompts, and frameworks. Partner with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists to bring applied machine learning capabilities from concept through production. Apply modern machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI, and AI agent approaches to Compensation challenges. Contribute to model development practices that support scalability, reliability, quality, and responsible use of AI. Learn Compensation domain concepts and use that context to build solutions that are practical, trusted, and valuable for customers. About You Basic Qualifications 5+ years of experience as part of a data science, machine learning, or software development team. 3+ years of experience using Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar tools. 3+ years of experience working with large-scale datasets, including data modeling, feature development, or data transformation. 3+ years of experience building, evaluating, or productizing machine learning models or algorithms. Other Qualifications Experience with machine learning, including selecting appropriate approaches, preparing data, training models, evaluating results, and applying models to practical product problems. Experience with model building, including feature engineering, experimentation, performance analysis, and iteration based on data and user needs. Experience with model development practices, including model evaluation, deployment considerations, monitoring, and improvement over time. Familiarity with model-based design concepts, including using models to represent complex systems, test assumptions, and guide solution design. Experience with deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI, distributed training, model hosting, or multi-agent AI systems. Experience bringing applied machine learning products from design through production. Ability to work collaboratively with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists to deliver customer-focused AI solutions. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and model behavior to technical and non-technical partners. Interest in learning HR and Compensation data, processes, and customer needs. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Large Language Models
jobs.jd: About the Role We are hiring a Research Engineer to help train our next generation of large language models. You will design, run, and scale training experiments on thousands of GPUs, and turn research ideas into production-grade models. You will join a small team of researchers and engineers who own the full model lifecycle: data, pre-training, post-training, and evaluation. Research and engineering are not separate here: you will write the code, run the experiments, and shape the conclusions. Key Responsibilities – What You'll Do Design and run large-scale pre-training and fine-tuning experiments, from small ablations to full training runs. Study scaling laws to choose model size, data mix, and hyperparameters under a fixed compute budget. Improve training efficiency through parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, FSDP), mixed precision, and custom CUDA or Triton kernels. Diagnose and fix training instabilities such as loss spikes, divergence, and hardware failures. Build and improve data pipelines, including filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, and dataset mixing. Implement ideas from recent research papers and test whether they hold at scale. Build evaluations that measure real model capabilities and track results rigorously. Work closely with the alignment, infrastructure, and product teams, and share findings through clear write-ups. Required Qualifications – What We're Looking For 3+ years of hands-on experience training deep learning models, or a PhD in a related field (computer science, mathematics, or physics). Strong Python skills and deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX. Practical experience with Transformer architectures, including attention, tokenization, embeddings, and positional encodings. Experience with distributed training on multi-node GPU clusters (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, or similar). Solid foundations in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and optimization. Ability to read a research paper, implement it from scratch, and judge whether it works. Rigorous experimental habits, including clean baselines, ablations, reproducible results, and experiment tracking. Clear written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Preferred Qualifications – Nice to Have Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL) or well-known open-source contributions. Experience pre-training an LLM from scratch, at any scale. Post-training experience, including supervised fine-tuning, RLHF, DPO, or other preference-optimization methods. GPU performance work involving CUDA, Triton, FlashAttention-style kernels, and profiling. Experience with efficient inference, including quantization, distillation, and optimized model serving. Cluster and infrastructure experience with Slurm, Kubernetes, or cloud GPU platforms. Large-scale data engineering experience (Spark, Ray, dataset curation for multilingual or domain-specific corpora). jobs.jd:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt  powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Berlin  team. In this role, you’ll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact. 

We’re hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers. 

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not. 

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.
  • Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.
  • Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.
  • Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via -----

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers worldwide. You'll work on open research problems at large scale. These include anomaly detection on non-stationary, high-dimensional telemetry, causal root-cause inference over constantly changing satellite and ground network graphs, and trustworthy ML for operators making decisions under pressure. You'll own the science agenda, from forming hypotheses and designing new models to putting them into production systems that protect customer connectivity. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Selling Partner Support Engagement
jobs.jd: Amazon's Selling Partner Support handles tens of millions of contacts annually worldwide. Our science team is transforming this experience by building AI agents that autonomously resolve seller issues, learn from every interaction, and continuously improve with minimal human intervention. These agents reason and adapt — from understanding the seller's context and selecting the right solution, to routing contacts optimally and automating resolution end-to-end. We do this in deep partnership with multiple engineering and product teams. We are looking for an Applied Scientist who is excited to work on reinforcement learning, agentic architectures, and large-scale production systems. You will be directly connected to the problems sellers face every day, translating real customer pain into science solutions that operate at massive scale. You will frame ambiguous business challenges as tractable machine learning problems and ship systems that measurably improve millions of seller interactions. Key job responsibilities - Optimize cost of agents in runtime by exploring deployment and domain adaptation of System One models. - Own research and development of reinforcement-learning based agent improvement systems, from problem formulation through production deployment and impact measurement. - Design approaches to preference learning, reward modeling, and policy optimization for conversational agents operating over real-world tools and APIs. - Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent quality across dimensions such as helpfulness, correctness, and safety. - Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deploy models into production systems serving sellers worldwide. - Contribute to the team's scientific impact through peer review, mentorship, and publications at peer-reviewed venues. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
jobs.jd:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.
  • Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.
  • Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
  • A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.
  • Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

  • First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.
  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.
  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.
  • Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.
  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.
  • Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust a

jobs.jd: Das baust du mit uns auf Wie wird aus Daten eine fundierte Entscheidung? Als Data Scientist entwickelst du Modelle, die Kundenverhalten verständlich machen und konkrete Verbesserungen ermöglichen. Wir bauen ein neues digitales Brokerage auf – mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Du gestaltest von Anfang an mit, wie wir Daten nutzen, um Kundenbedürfnisse besser zu verstehen, Angebote gezielter auszurichten und Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei begleitest du deine Modelle von der ersten Fragestellung bis zum Einsatz im Alltag. Das wirst du bei uns machen Du übersetzt konkrete Geschäftsfragen in statistische Analysen und Machine-Learning-Modelle – beispielsweise zur Abwanderung, zu Sparplan-Kündigungen, zur Aktivierung nach dem Onboarding oder zum Kundenwert. Du bereitest relevante Daten auf, entwickelst geeignete Merkmale und wählst die Methoden aus, die zur jeweiligen Fragestellung passen. Du erkennst anhand von Daten mögliche Beratungsanlässe und unterstützt dabei, Kunden gezielt an die Volks- und Raiffeisenbanken überzuleiten. Du segmentierst Kunden nach Verhalten und Potenzial und schaffst damit die Grundlage für eine gezieltere Ansprache durch Marketing und Service. Du prüfst die Qualität und Aussagekraft deiner Modelle mit geeigneten Validierungsverfahren und machst ihre Möglichkeiten und Grenzen transparent. Du bringst Modelle gemeinsam mit den IT- und Plattformteams in den produktiven Einsatz, überwachst ihre Güte und entwickelst sie bei Bedarf weiter. Du dokumentierst Datenbasis, Methoden und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar und erklärbar und berücksichtigst dabei die relevanten Anforderungen aus DSGVO und EU AI Act. Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich für die beteiligten Fachbereiche auf und leitest konkrete Empfehlungen für Prozesse und Kampagnen ab. Das bringst du mit Du hast praktische Erfahrung als Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und bereits statistische oder Machine-Learning-Modelle eigenständig entwickelt. Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Data Science, Statistik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung mit. Du beherrschst Python und SQL sicher und arbeitest mit gängigen Machine-Learning-Bibliotheken. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Statistik und Machine Learning mit und kannst Methoden passend zur Fragestellung auswählen, Modelle validieren und Ergebnisse kritisch einordnen. Du hast Modelle bereits über den Prototyp hinaus in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht und kennst die Anforderungen an einen verlässlichen Betrieb. Du denkst vom Geschäftsnutzen her und kannst beurteilen, wann ein Modell einen sinnvollen Beitrag leistet und wann eine einfachere Lösung ausreicht. Du erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und arbeitest sicher mit fachlichen und technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen. Du arbeitest pragmatisch, sorgfältig und eigenverantwortlich, strukturierst deine Projekte und setzt auch in einem dynamischen Aufbauumfeld klare Prioritäten. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss Erfahrung im Finanzsektor, beispielsweise bei einem Broker, einer Bank, einem FinTech oder im Asset Management. Erfahrung mit Modellen zur Abwanderung, Aktivierung, Kundensegmentierung oder Kundenwertbestimmung. Erfahrung mit Cloud-Datenplattformen wie Databricks. Erfahrung mit der nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation und Erklärbarkeit von Modellen in einem regulierten Umfeld. Das erwartet dich bei uns Raum für deine Ideen: Hier kannst du nicht nur mitreden, sondern mitgestalten. Deine Ideen sind gefragt und du hast die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln. Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbruchstimmung treffen auf die Sicherheit und Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Deine Benefits Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing un-crewed maritime and air domain systems that leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep experience developing, testing, validating and deploying machine-learning based sensor processing and the technical toolchains they rely on. The Senior Machine Learning Engineer strives to leverage their experience to rapidly architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design, development, integration and support of machine learning models for perception and data pipelines for a variety of autonomous systems across multiple sensor modalities
  • Develop software to manage and automate the machine learning lifecycle, including data management, pipelining, labeling and training
  • Manage model selection, training, validation, evaluation, deployment and regression testing
  • Manage training data sourcing and integration, and quality
  • Develop tools and processes for machine learning in a classified environment
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers, to ensure effective system integration and testing

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in a senior role with the delivery of a production grade software system with a mature machine learning component
  • Experience with the design, implementation and maintenance of ML Operations, including data acquisition, labeling, data curation, pipeline management, continuous integration, model versioning, and monitoring
  • Ability to collaborate with data scientists and stakeholders to define and implement robust validation and verification strategies
  • Experience with the delivery of computer vision capabilities, from the data side as well as the model side
  • Capacity to work holistically on machine learning enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2) 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with the delivery of capability with a public sector customer
  • Experience with workflow management tools such as flyte, airflow, and kubeflow
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch
  • Experience with edge ML applications
  • Experience with inference engines such as TensorRT
  • Experience writing C++, Go, Python or Rust
  • Proficiency in data management and traceability techniques to maintain high-quality datasets and enable reproducibility of experiments and results
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information,

jobs.title: Sr Hardware Development Engineer, Edge & AI/ML Accelerator Team
jobs.jd: AWS operates a fleet of servers at the Edge, powering various workloads at cloud scale. Our team defines the server architectures, drives the hardware designs, and owns the fleet quality for these platforms — from component selection through datacenter operations. If you want to shape the physical hardware that frontier models train on, this is the role. We are seeking a Cloud Hardware Development Engineer to define server architectures based on workload demand, translate them into detailed component specifications, and drive validation from PCBA bring-up through rack integration. You will lead ODM design partners through development and production, triage hardware issues across manufacturing and datacenters, and own fleet quality metrics post-launch. What You Will Do Your designs span thermal, mechanical, power, and signal integrity across GPU-accelerated platforms. You will drive validation from first silicon through fleet-scale deployment, triage failures correlating across PCIe, power delivery, memory, and accelerator interconnects, and feed root cause findings back into design improvements. When a new server platform launches at a large scale, the architecture, component choices, and quality gates are yours. Why You Will Love It Your programs launch the servers that power various services and applications at the Edge. You will see your architecture decisions scale to a large fleet of servers. The team is deeply technical and high-trust — you own platforms end to end from architecture definition through fleet operations. The Ideal Candidate You think across the full hardware stack — from silicon packaging and power delivery to rack-level thermal and mechanical design. You are as comfortable reviewing a schematic as you are analyzing fleet failure data. You drive quality through data, not assumption, and you hold design partners to the same standard you hold yourself. You mentor and develop junior engineers, contribute to hiring, and share your expertise to make the team stronger. Key job responsibilities Architecture & Design * Define server architectures based on workload demand and customer requirements, translating them into detailed designs and component specifications * Work with interdisciplinary teams of component, firmware, test, qualification, and integration engineers to deliver cohesive designs * Drive design reviews with ODM/JDM partners covering schematic, layout, BOM, and manufacturing DFx (Design for Test, Design for Manufacturing) Validation & Bring-up * Define and execute validation strategies from PCBA bring-up through server and rack integration — covering power sequencing, signal integrity, thermal characterization, and accelerator interconnect performance * Own hardware debug during EVT/DVT/PVT builds, correlating failures across PCIe, power rails, memory channels, and networking subsystems * Triage hardware issues at both ODM facilities and datacenters, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions Fleet Quality & Continuous Improvement * Own fleet quality metrics post-launch: server-level annualized failure rates and component-level failure modes * Monitor operational telemetry to identify systemic issues and drive design or process changes for current and future platforms * Partner with test and automation teams to improve manufacturing yield and reduce test dwell times Cross-Team Collaboration * Work with EC2 architecture teams to align on instance definitions, workload requirements, and platform trade-offs * Drive ODM/JDM design partners through development milestones and production ramp * Collaborate with firmware, software, and operations teams to ensure designs are debuggable, serviceable, and automation-ready May require occasional ( A day in the life You start the day reviewing thermal and power validation data from an EVT build at your ODM partner. Mid-morning, you join a design review to close signal integrity findings on a high-speed accelerator interconnect. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet quality signal — correlating component-level failure data with manufacturing lot information to identify a systemic issue. You end the day aligning with architecture teams on requirements for the next-generation platform. About the team The Hardware Engineering Edge & AI/ML Server platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching Edge & GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Amazon Robotics (AR) Sortation
jobs.jd: Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply state-of-the-art advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling, and fun. Our Team The Amazon Robotics Sortation Analytics team discovers insights in vast and varied robotic data to help our engineering teams understand how their technologies operate across Amazon’s network of warehouses. We collaborate with designers, software and hardware engineers, and operations teams to understand product requirements, make feature trade-offs, design, and operate new applications of Amazon Robotics technology. We conduct relevant, insightful analysis and communicate the results through white papers and presentations. Our methods include design of experiments, statistical modeling, machine learning, financial analysis, and data visualization. Key job responsibilities * Developing predictive models and simulations to analyze complex, large-scale datasets and uncover insights to improve customer experience, cost efficiency, capital investment effectiveness, and automation utilization. * Creating compelling data visualizations that communicate end-to-end system performance and identify optimization opportunities. * Establishing robust data analysis frameworks and KPIs to quantify the impact of your solutions and evaluate tradeoffs between potentially contending goals. * Collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to understand their needs, translate them into data-driven projects, and deliver impactful results. A day in the life You will collaborate cross-functionally with engineering teams, program managers, and leaders throughout the organization to deliver projects aimed at characterizing and improving the performance of new robotic automation technology in Amazon's network of warehouses. In this role, you will use a combination of unified and disparate data sources to uncover insights delivered through decision-driving analytics white-papers and automated data visualizations to influence the development and deployment of highly innovative robotic technology. You will collaborate with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Engineers, and Program Managers to define and deliver world class models and insights to shape the robotic technology landscape. jobs.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Language: fluency in English and French/German Qualifications Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. jobs.title: Sr. System Development Engineer, Edge & AI/ML Accelerator Team
jobs.jd: AWS operates a fleet of servers at the Edge, powering various workloads at cloud scale. We are building the automation, diagnostics, and predictive intelligence that keeps this fleet running at peak. If you want to work at the intersection of hardware, software, and scale — where your code directly prevents customer-impacting failures — this is the role. We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer to build automation software, diagnostic tooling, and fleet health infrastructure for our compute platforms. You will work across multiple teams and organizations to design scalable, reliable systems for our accelerated compute fleet. What You Will Do You will tackle problems no one has fully defined yet — spanning hardware, firmware, kernel, and software simultaneously. You will own systems end to end, writing code that prevents failures rather than reacts to them, and building automation that replaces manual toil with intelligent self-healing. You will work across PCIe topology, Networking, and critical subsystem diagnostics, Linux drivers, and telemetry pipelines to correlate signals and isolate faults at fleet scale. Why You Will Love It Your automation runs at a large scale across servers in the cloud. When you ship, you see failure rates move within days. The team is small enough that your decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you will always have experts to learn from across hardware, firmware, and software. The Ideal Candidate You know the full stack from bare-metal to userland. You debug at the intersection of components, not just within them. You build at cloud scale and care how your systems decisions impact customers. You are an excellent communicator who can drive alignment across hardware, software, and operations teams. Key job responsibilities Fleet Health & Predictive Infrastructure 1. Build and own the automation infrastructure for fleet health at a large scale of servers, driving toward zero-touch operations that detect, diagnose, triage, and remediate faults without human intervention 2. Design and develop test frameworks, test coverage strategies, and diagnostic tooling to validate hardware functionality, detect faults, and ensure qualification coverage across the platform lifecycle. 3. Design predictive failure detection using telemetry, sensor data, error trending, and log correlation to identify degrading components before customer impact 4. Develop monitoring dashboards and alerting for real-time fleet health visibility across manufacturing, lab, and production environments 5. Design scalable test automation for hardware bring-up, regression, and qualification — reducing manufacturing test cycle times without sacrificing coverage through intelligent test sequencing and parallel execution 2. Build data pipelines correlating test results, sensor telemetry, and component-level data to identify systemic yield issues and drive upstream fixes 3. Engage with ODMs and design partners on testability, diagnostic coverage, and automation requirements during hardware design and bring-up phases — influencing functional and performance readiness of the platform 3. Partner with datacenter operations to close the loop between field failures, manufacturing escapes, and design improvements Operational Excellence 1. Participate in post-incident reviews, identify contributing causes and drive permanent fixes that eliminate whole classes of risk 2. You end the day reviewing a pull request from a teammate on a new telemetry correlation engine, and updating your manufacturing test coverage dashboard with the latest yield data. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Fauna
jobs.jd: We are seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to push the state of the art in robot learning and help bring capable robots out of the lab and into everyday homes at Fauna Robotics. In this role, you will design novel algorithms across perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning, and multi-task learning, closing the gap between research and real-world deployment. You will work where robotics research meets production systems. You'll combine hands-on technical work with scientific leadership to guide the team toward the most promising directions. Working closely with software engineers and scientists, you will turn new ideas into robust solutions for dynamic, unstructured home environments. Homes bring challenges that structured settings like warehouses don't, and consumer-grade sensors and actuators have real limits, so this work calls for creative, out-of-the-box approaches. jobs.jd: The Creative X team within Amazon Advertising builds AI systems that understand and evaluate ad images and videos, so advertisers of every size can deliver high-quality experiences to customers. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist , Amazon Leo Networking Software
jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world, including those underserved by traditional infrastructure. Operating a live constellation and its ground network at scale means service disruptions are an inevitable reality, and how quickly we detect them, understand them, and prevent them from recurring defines the trust we earn as a connectivity provider. We are seeking a talented Senior Data Scientist to build the next generation of observability and availability science for the Leo network. Leo already detects outages, notifies affected customers, and restores service. The frontier is prediction and prevention: reasoning over complex network and ground-segment telemetry to autonomously detect anomalies before they reach customers, attribute root cause automatically across a sprawling event surface, and rationalize a large, still-maturing metric set so responders trust what the system tells them. In this role you will work backwards from the needs of customers and operations teams. You will own the scientific direction end to end, partnering closely with network engineers, the Network Operations Center, and the Incident Management team, and the Software and Networking orginization to translate a long-term science vision into concrete research and delivery roadmaps. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Own the observability and availability science end to end, from long-term vision to research roadmap to production delivery, working backwards from the needs of customers, the NOC, and network engineering. * Develop time-series and graph-based models with dynamic baselining that detect network and ground-segment anomalies before they cross the High Severity threshold, enabling proactive investigation rather than reactive response. * Reason over complex, multi-system telemetry to attribute cause automatically during live HSEs and LSEs, so Call Leaders and engineers spend time mitigating, not hunting. * Provide the science behind the network's bucketed availability decomposition (geometric and satellite coverage, ground and network segments, customer terminals, payload, and planning), attributing every movement to a true cause rather than noise, so leadership steers on signal and engineering effort lands where it actually moves availability and throughput. * Deliver the models, analyses, and metrics that feed the daily system readiness and validation review consumed by senior leadership and product and engineering, turning availability and throughput data into a defensible, evidence-based read on progress against GA entry criteria. * Own the recurring, fleet-wide "hot topic" investigations that span ASIC, firmware, payload, network, and planning, separating correlated symptoms from true root cause across thousands of nodes, quantifying how much availability or throughput each is costing, and answering whether it is a launch-blocking risk and whether it is improving. * Deliver alert correlation and deduplication, false-positive reduction, and metric-quality scoring so responders trust what the system tells them, directly supporting a large, still-maturing KPI set. * Tie your science to the unit the org actually measures: reduce detection and attribution time, raise availability against the network's bar, and increase the share of events prevented before customer impact. * Partner day to day with the Network Operations Center, Network Engineering, and the Incident Management (Call Leader) program; sit on live HSE/LSE bridges as the science partner and turn event learnings into model improvements. * Feed COEs and RCAs back into detection and attribution so recurring signatures are caught earlier, and help design and score gamedays that stress-test both the network and your models against real, closed events. * Build and deploy production pipelines on AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue) with model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and explainability, because operations teams must be able to trust and act on model output under pressure. * Set data-science standards, mentor scientists, and drive best practices across the Leo networking organization as the science function scales. * Produce explainable output and written narratives that let responders and leaders three or more levels up act on your models during and between events. A day in the life You might start by reviewing overnight anomaly detections and availability movements, join an HSE bridge as the science partner by midday, and spend the afternoon refining root-cause attribution models or presenting availability findings at the readiness review. About the team Amazon Leo Networking Software builds and operates the software behind Leo's satellite and ground network. Our science function partners with the NOC, Network Engineering and Incident Management to make the network more available and resilient, moving from reacting to outages to predicting and preventing them. As a Data Scientist III, you'll help shape that function as it grows. - 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 4+ years of data scientist experience - Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression - 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience - Experience managing data pipelines - Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.jd:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. Working with text, images and behavioural data, you’ll apply practical machine learning techniques to evolving detection challenges.

You’ll work closely with Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Product Managers and engineers to turn ideas into reliable production solutions. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects across the ML lifecycle, from understanding the data and developing models to deployment, evaluation and ongoing maintenance.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop, evaluate and improve machine learning models that detect harmful content and behaviour at scale.
  • Engineer features, prepare training and evaluation datasets, understanding their limitations and addressing issues such as noisy labels, class imbalance and data leakage.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate models into production and develop reliable training and inference pipelines using established tooling.
  • Work with Decision Scientists and Product Managers to define success metrics and evaluate model improvements through offline analysis and online experimentation, balancing detection coverage with false positives and member experience.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in their effectiveness and improve them as harmful behaviour and underlying data evolve.
  • Write reliable, maintainable and reproducible code, document your work, share learnings and contribute ideas to the team’s roadmap.

About you 

  • Practical experience developing machine learning solutions, with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistics and probability theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn or PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience preparing training datasets, engineering features, training models and evaluating them against baselines and metrics.
  • Experience applying machine learning to at least one of the following: tabular or behavioural data, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with the production ML lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring and retraining.
  • Ability to break down problems into manageable steps, work independently within an agreed scope and seek input when needed.
  • Ability to communicate your approach, findings and trade-offs clearly, collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues, and learn from feedback.
  • Motivation to apply machine learning to member safety, with care for data privacy and the consequences of incorrect predictions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud detection, content classification or other Trust & Safety applications.
  • Experience with transformers, multimodal models or LLM-based workflows.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme

jobs.jd: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT RAMP LABS Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money. ABOUT THE ROLE Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step - Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping - Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output - Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up - Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack - Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works WHAT YOU NEED - Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped - Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference - Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production - Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise - The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped - Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight - Clear written communication NICE-TO-HAVE - Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom) - Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora - Post-training or hosting open-source models for high-volume inference - Distributed systems background - Public work we can look at: an agent framework, an open-source project, a write-up or a paper BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL) -
