jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: AI Catalog
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
  • Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
  • Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers , zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past. Rethink it with LINKIT. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Experience with cloud-based ML tooling (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock) and data workflows. Demonstrated experience training and deploying supervised learning models, ideally in production environments (a plus). Ability to work independently and collaboratively on cross-functional teams. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage working on multiple projects in parallel. The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment. Location: This position is remote based in Mexico. Must reside in Mexico and we have an office in Mexico City (Reforma area), if you're interested in going into the office. Not required, but optional. Sponsorship: AlertMedia does not sponsor employment visas. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in Mexico without the need for sponsorship now or in the future. By applying, you acknowledge that all interviews and assessments must be completed by you and not by another individual acting on your behalf. jobs.title: GenAI Engineer
jobs.jd: Iedereen kan een prompt schrijven. Een AI-oplossing bouwen waar een organisatie echt op durft te vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) maak jij het verschil tussen een interessante demo en een oplossing die elke dag werkt in een echt proces. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker. De uitdaging Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op. Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy. Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework. Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen. Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen. Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering. Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar ben je wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). jobs.title: AI Engineer - RL Post-Training and Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability. We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team. Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure. Your mission The role As an AI Engineer for RL Post-Training and Agentic Systems, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the infrastructure we use to post-train our robot foundation models with large-scale reinforcement learning and deploy them as agentic systems across our robot fleet. You own the full loop - from distributed rollouts in simulation and on real robots, through policy optimization, to serving our models on cloud and on-prem infrastructure. The systems you build close the gap between research and deployment, turning real-world experience into better models, fast and safely. This is a full-time, permanent position. Your profile Key responsibilities Distributed RL Infrastructure: Develop scalable infrastructure for RL post-training of multi-billion-parameter robot foundation models, coordinating distributed actors, learners and reward models across GPU clusters, simulation and our robot fleet Model Serving: Own our cloud and on-prem serving infrastructure, delivering low-latency, high-throughput inference for both RL rollouts and production robots, including fast weight synchronization between training and inference. Agentic Workflows: Build the infrastructure to orchestrate, evaluate and monitor agentic systems that combine our models with planning, tool use and robot skills to complete long-horizon tasks. Who we are looking for We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together. Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience building and operating large-scale RL or post-training systems for large models, including actor-learner architectures, asynchronous rollouts and off-policy correction. Core Skills: Deep expertise in RL post-training and high-performance model serving. In detail: RL Post-Training: PPO, GRPO and related policy-optimization algorithms, reward modeling, and frameworks such as veRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-RL, TRL or Ray RLlib. Model Serving: Inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, batching and KV-cache optimization, quantization, and serving platforms such as Ray Serve, Triton Inference Server or KServe. Distributed Systems: Ray, Kubernetes and/or Slurm, fault-tolerant orchestration of heterogeneous workloads, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. Core Stack: Python, PyTorch and/or JAX, CUDA, NCCL, and distributed training with FSDP or Megatron-Core. A plus: Building agentic systems and evaluation harnesses for long-horizon, multi-step tasks; robot learning in simulation and sim-to-real transfer (Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, domain randomization); edge and on-robot inference (NVIDIA Jetson/Orin/Thor, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime) under real-time latency constraints; robotics middleware and data formats (ROS 2, MCAP) Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and an engineer with a research mindset who understands the workflows of cutting-edge AI research and supports them with rigorous software engineering. Why us? The Team : Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards. Smart Strategy : We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations. Resources : We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission. Historic Opportunity : Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.jd: About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability. We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team. Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure. Your mission The role As an AI Research Engineer, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership to define the research direction for how our humanoid robots learn. You research self-learning systems for robot foundation models, turn ideas into working prototypes and push the state of the art - measured not by how good a result looks in a paper, but by how well it holds up against strong baselines and, ultimately, on real hardware. You build on our large-scale training, RL post-training and simulation infrastructure, and your research needs shape where it goes next. This is a full-time, permanent position. Your profile Key responsibilities Research on Self-Learning Systems: Develop methods that let our robot foundation models learn from large-scale video and robot data and keep improving from experience - across pre-training, imitation learning and RL post-training - for humanoid locomotion and manipulation Prototyping: Turn research ideas and new papers into working prototypes quickly, in simulation and on physical robots. Pushing the State of the Art: Track the frontier of robot learning and foundation models, identify what matters for real-world deployment, and develop methods that move beyond it Experimentation: Design and run experiments at scale on our GPU fleet - from simulation to hardware - with clean setups that produce results the team can trust. Evaluation: Benchmark rigorously against strong baselines using our simulation benchmarks and real-world tests, run ablations and make results reproducible, so decisions rest on evidence rather than impressions. Sim-to-Real Collaboration: Work with the simulation, hardware and controls teams so that what is learned in simulation transfers to the robot. Who we are looking for We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and are ready to move beyond demos to real-world deployment. Experience: 3+ years of research experience in machine learning or robotics, ideally with a track record in robot learning or large-scale models. [A PhD in a related field is a plus.] [Publications at top venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS or ICML are a plus.] Core Skills: Deep knowledge of learning-based methods for robotics and strong engineering skills to implement them. In detail: Learning Methods: Hands-on research experience with robot foundation models or policy learning - e.g. VLAs, diffusion/flow-matching policies, imitation learning or RL post-training. Engineering: Strong Python and PyTorch and/or JAX; able to write research code that others can build on. Simulation: Experience with physics simulators for robot learning (MuJoCo/MjLab, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or comparable). Experimental Rigor: Experience designing experiments, choosing meaningful baselines and evaluating results honestly. A plus: Deploying learned policies on real robots; training large models on multi-node GPU clusters; multimodal or video models. Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment - and you care whether a method works on the robot, not just on the benchmark. Why us? The Team : Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards. Smart Strategy : We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations. Resources : We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission. Historic Opportunity : Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market. We are an equal opportunity employer. Legal notice · Privacy policy Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
jobs.jd:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

  • Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.
  • Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.
  • Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.
  • Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.
  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.
  • Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.
  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.
  • Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.
  • Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.
  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.
  • Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.
  • Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves

  • Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.
  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.
  • A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.
  • Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.
  • Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.
  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.
  • Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.
  • Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer – Applied AI FDE
jobs.jd: Team Bio: ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. Why This Role Matters: Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. As a Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. Who You Are: You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points. You will: Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams What You’ll Do: Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code What Success Looks Like: Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one What You Bring: Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL) Machine Learning: Foundations of MLflow, Weights & Biases, LoRA, PEFT, SageMaker, Vertex AI, AzureML, Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, SHAP, LIME, pandas, Spark, SQL LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters Preferred Qualifications: Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Startups
jobs.jd: About the team The AI Deployment Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the role We are seeking a technically proficient, product-minded engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, helping them optimize their own systems and turning those learnings into durable improvements across OpenAI’s research and products. You will partner deeply on complex workflows, identify the gaps that matter, and help transform those gaps into reproducible evaluations, technical insights - helping shape OpenAI's research and product direction. This role is well suited to engineers who are equally comfortable debugging a workflow, iterating on prompts or agents, designing evaluations, and collaborating across research and product. You should be excited by ambiguous, high-impact problems and motivated by the opportunity to shape how advanced AI systems improve in practice. In this role, you will: - Work directly with strategic startup customers to understand critical workflows, uncover failure modes, and identify high-impact opportunities for improvement. - Prototype and iterate on prompts, agents, and workflow designs to better understand system behavior and unlock customer value. - Synthesize and deliver valuable feedback to the Product and Research teams, turning real usage patterns into clear, reproducible evals, benchmarks, and technical artifacts that improve model and product quality and ensure customer-grounded learnings influence roadmap and model development. - Build repeatable tools, patterns, and evaluation approaches that raise the quality bar across multiple use cases. - Operate with strong judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing immediate technical problem-solving with longer-term system improvement. - Build relationships within the startup ecosystem, serving as a technical partner to both individual customers and the broader community. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have strong software engineering & AI fundamentals. For example, experience as a startup CTO, software engineer, ML engineer, Data Scientist or equivalent. Experience shipping production systems end-to-end is a strong plus. - Have experience as a technical founder, or engineer at an early stage startup - Have familiarity with, or interest in, model training pipelines and reinforcement learning. - Have experience building AI applications, agents, or evaluation systems, and can reason clearly about model behavior in complex workflows. - Are comfortable working directly with highly technical users and translating their challenges into concrete technical signals. - Can move fluidly between prototyping, debugging, evaluation design, and cross-functional collaboration. - Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences. - Bring high agency, strong product sense, and a bias toward building durable improvements rather than one-off fixes About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, GPU Code Generation for Machine Learning Inference
jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, CA, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA is seeking talented engineers to join the TensorRT team and advance high-performance AI inference on NVIDIA GPUs. Our team develops software that accelerates state-of-the-art generative AI models for local and enterprise deployments. We solve challenging problems in GPU code generation, just-in-time compilation, and inference optimization to deliver high performance across diverse models and hardware configurations. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop advanced GPU inference software for TensorRT. We’re looking for engineers with strong experience in GPU optimization and compiler development who can translate a deep understanding of GPU execution into efficient code generation and measurable improvements in generative AI inference. What you’ll be doing: Design and implement efficient GPU code generation techniques in TensorRT that balance generated code performance, compilation overhead, and startup latency. Develop compiler optimizations, including operator fusion, dynamic scheduling, and specialization for model shapes, data types, and GPU architectures. Profile workloads and analyze generated GPU code to identify bottlenecks and guide compiler and runtime improvements. Develop robust, maintainable software in C++, and Python for tooling, testing, and performance analysis. Collaborate with GPU architects, kernel developers, compiler engineers, and deep learning experts to guide hardware and software design. What we need to see: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 4+ years of relevant software development experience, including contributions to a substantial codebase or project. Strong proficiency in C++ and experience building performance-critical software. Understanding of GPU architecture and parallel programming concepts, including memory hierarchies, thread execution, synchronization, and resource utilization. A rigorous approach to performance analysis and debugging, with the ability to validate numerical correctness and explain performance tradeoffs. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaborate across teams. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience developing or optimizing GPU kernels using CUDA, Triton, CuTe DSL, CUTLASS, or other GPU programming languages. Experience with MLIR compiler infrastructure, familiarity with intermediate representations, lowering, optimization passes, and GPU code generation. Familiarity with NVIDIA Tensor Core architecture, mixed-precision computation, quantization, or low-level GPU performance analysis using tools such as NVIDIA Nsight. Experience developing inference frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang. A track record of measurable performance improvements in production software or contributions to GPU programming and compiler projects. At NVIDIA, you’ll work with engineers across GPU architecture, compilers, and AI software to solve demanding performance problems. If you are curious and enjoy understanding how hardware executes code and building software that pushes its capabilities, join us in shaping the future of generative AI inference. #LI-Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 23, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Secure Third Party Tools (S3T)
jobs.jd: Secure Third Party Tools team looking for a Senior Applied Scientist with generative AI experience. We seek a hands-on leader and team player who excels in the end-to-end development cycles from research and launch. This leader will conduct applied research and take the resulting models into production. We work in an ambiguous and dynamic space where this leader will need to independently define problems more often than solving pre-scoped problems. Strong candidates will demonstrate the ability to scale themselves by teaching others and simplify complexities. With the team, you will influence the science roadmap, define model quality measurements, and partner extensively to deliver solutions. Decisions draw on varied, unstructured data in a rapidly changing security landscape. Models need to codify human expertise, detect new issues, and prove approaches, to develop solutions that raise security postures practically, not theoretically. Key job responsibilities - Set and follow the science direction. Define the research agenda, success metrics, and multi quarter roadmap for applied science in third party security, and present tradeoffs and recommendations to senior leaders. - Automate security decision making. Build machine learning and large language model (LLM) systems that analyze security information and help teams make faster, more consistent third party security decisions. - Build agentic AI workflows. Design agent based and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems that automate multi step security work and bring in human experts where judgment is needed. - Improve third party risk insight. Develop models that connect information across systems, identify changes in risk over time, and help teams focus on the issues that matter most. - Earn trust in model decisions. Define evaluation methods, benchmarks, and quality controls, and decide when an automated decision is reliable and when it needs expert review. - Raise the team's capability. Mentor scientists and engineers, set best practices for responsible AI in security, and share results through publications and internal forums. About the team Secure Third Party Tools, part of Amazon Security, builds tools to help evaluate, remediate, and monitor vendor’s security with confidence. Scientists work on a cross-functional team building and redesigning platforms to improve deterministic automated security at the pace and scale of Amazon. jobs.jd: AI-native startups now train their own models, post-train open-weight models for their products, and serve inference at volumes where cost per output decides their margins. The startup team of the AWS Frontier AI Services puts applied scientists to work directly with those founders and their engineers. We're hiring a Senior Applied Scientist in North America to own those engagements with our strategists end to end: scope the problem with the founding team, design and run the experiments, and ship working code into the startup's stack on AWS. The problems are open-ended and the timelines run in weeks, so your scientific judgment sets both the approach and the bar for done. Then deliver against them in six-to-twelve-week engagements, with the startup's own engineers working alongside you. - Improve model quality for the startup's use case by post-training open-weight models. That covers supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning (for example GRPO), distillation, and the synthetic data and evaluation sets that show whether it worked. - Cut training and inference cost and latency on NVIDIA GPUs and AWS Trainium. Profile where the compute goes, apply quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, batching, parallelism and kernel-level tuning, and measure cost per output before and after. - Invent new methods when published ones fall short of the customer's target, and publish the results at peer-reviewed venues, on AWS blogs and as open-source code. - Turn each engagement into assets the next one can reuse: reference implementations, evaluation harnesses and playbooks. Before anyone changes the model, you agree on an evaluation set built from their own camera footage. Mid-morning you check an overnight reinforcement-learning run for another startup: reward is up but two task categories regressed, so you write up why and what to try next. After lunch you join an AWS account manager and a GenAI strategist to scope a request from a voice AI company that needs lower inference latency before it scales up. You leave with a two-week profiling plan and one go/no-go metric. You end the day reviewing a teammate's experiment design and editing a workshop paper drawn from last quarter's engagement. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer, LPX
jobs.jd: We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer! NVIDIA is seeking engineers to develop algorithms and optimizations for our LPX inference and compiler stack. You will work at the intersection of large-scale systems, compilers, and deep learning, crafting how neural network workloads map onto future NVIDIA platforms. This is your chance to be part of something outstandingly innovative! What you’ll be doing: Build, develop, and maintain high-performance runtime and compiler components, focusing on end-to-end inference optimization. Define and implement mappings of large-scale inference workloads onto NVIDIA’s systems. Extend and integrate with NVIDIA’s SW ecosystem, contributing to libraries, tooling, and interfaces that enable seamless deployment of models across platforms. Benchmark, profile, and monitor key performance and efficiency metrics to ensure the compiler generates efficient mappings of neural network graphs to our inference hardware. Collaborate closely with hardware architects and design teams to feedback software observations, influence future architectures, and codesign features that unlock new performance and efficiency points. Prototype and evaluate new compilation and runtime techniques, including graph transformations, scheduling strategies, and memory/layout optimizations tailored to spatial processors. Publish and present technical work on novel compilation approaches for inference and related spatial accelerators at top tier ML, compiler, and computer architecture venues. What we need to see: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience, with 5 years of relevant experience. Strong software engineering background with proficiency in systems level programming (e.g., C/C++ and/or Rust) and solid CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and concurrency. Hands on experience with compiler or runtime development, including IR design, optimization passes, or code generation. Experience with LLVM and/or MLIR, including building custom passes, dialects, or integrations. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, and experience working with portable graph formats such as ONNX. Solid understanding of parallel and heterogeneous compute architectures, such as GPUs, spatial accelerators, or other domain specific processors. Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience using profiling, tracing, and benchmarking tools to drive performance improvements. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across hardware, systems, and software teams. Ideal candidates will have direct experience with MLIR based compilers or other multilevel IR stacks, especially in the context of graph based deep learning workloads. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Prior work on spatial or dataflow architectures, including static scheduling, pipeline parallelism, or tensor parallelism at scale. Contributions to opensource ML frameworks, compilers, or runtime systems, particularly in areas related to performance or scalability. Demonstrated research impact, such as publications or presentations at conferences like PLDI, CGO, ASPLOS, ISCA, MICRO, MLSys, NeurIPS, or similar. Experience with large-scale AI distributed inference or training systems, including performance modeling and capacity planning for multi rack deployments. #LI-Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 135,000 CAD – 185,000 CAD for Level 3; and 170,000 CAD – 220,000 CAD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: As an AI Forward Deployed ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one. You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems. What you'll be doing: Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments. Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability. Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS. Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster. Feed the product. Custom integrations you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS. Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you. What you bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product . Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale. Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads. jobs.jd: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You’ll Do We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality. You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab. The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next. Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Quantum Device Integration, Amazon's Center for Quantum Computing, Device Team
jobs.jd: The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) in Pasadena, CA, is hiring an Applied Scientist to lead integration research and development for superconducting quantum devices. You will design, model, and test the chip-to-chip, chip-to-package, and signal-delivery interfaces that let superconducting quantum computers scale, and you will characterize integrated assemblies at cryogenic temperatures to learn how integration choices affect qubit performance, yield, and manufacturability. You will join a multi-disciplinary team of theoretical and experimental physicists, materials scientists, and hardware and software engineers working at the forefront of quantum computing. You will carry integration technologies from concept through hardware demonstration, build the test standards and automation that make results reproducible across devices, and collaborate with fabrication, hardware, and circuit design engineers to remove the dominant sources of yield loss. You will also contribute to multi-year roadmap planning for integration and scaling capabilities and help establish the scientific foundation for this capability area within the Device team. Key job responsibilities In this role you will develop the integration technologies that let superconducting quantum computers scale. Your work will span four connected areas: - Integration research and development: Design, model, and test integration solutions for superconducting quantum devices, including chip-to-chip, chip-to-package, and signal-delivery interfaces. Build electromagnetic, thermal, and mechanical models to predict and optimize performance, and characterize integrated assemblies at cryogenic temperatures. - Scaling technologies: Develop and evaluate approaches to scaling superconducting quantum hardware against yield, reusability, manufacturability, and scalability, and carry the most promising ones from concept through hardware demonstration. - Test standards and automation: Define test standards that give rigorous, reproducible measurements of how integration affects qubit coherence, loss, and crosstalk. Automate data collection and reporting against these standards so characterization scales across devices and configurations. - Yield and manufacturability: Work with fabrication, hardware, printed circuit board, and circuit design engineers to identify and remove the largest sources of yield loss and integration uncertainty, and to design processes and components that are reused across device generations and manufactured at scale. About the team The Device team at the AWS Center for Quantum Computing designs, builds, and measures the superconducting quantum devices at the heart of our processors, and develops the integration and packaging that turn individual devices into working systems. You will work alongside physicists, materials scientists, and hardware and software engineers across design, fabrication, measurement, and theory, in a lab built for rapid iteration from concept to cryogenic test. Over the coming years the team's focus is making superconducting quantum hardware scale, and this role establishes integration as a scientific capability area within that effort. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. jobs.title: Senior Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: As a Senior Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the German market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Senior Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As a Senior Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 5+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. jobs.jd: Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity and inclusion of our teams within the organization. How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team! Prime Air's Flight Sciences High-Fidelity Methods (HFM) team is seeking an outstanding Applied Scientist to develop and verify drone systems models and flight physics models. These models form the backbone of every flight simulation performed within Prime Air, directly informing aircraft design, system verification, certification, and business decisions. The HFM team's work enables prediction of critical vehicle performance metrics—including range, maneuverability, tracking error, and aircraft stability—and connects vehicle design and operational decisions to business outcomes such as customer reachability. Our models are also a crucial input to the design of flight control algorithms and software verification. Because the accuracy and reliability of these models underpin so many facets of Prime Air's mission, the scientist in this role will have broad, high-visibility impact on the program's success. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Prime Video - Ads Science
jobs.jd: Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Key job responsibilities The science challenges include: - Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time. - Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals. - Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles. - Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies. - Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric. A day in the life - Lead the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind - Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale - Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization - Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements - Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions - Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions About the team Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale. - 5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience - PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
